data.one_liner: A wrapper around Flutter date and time pickers to integrate them with reactive_forms.
data.what_it_does: It provides form-integrated date and time picker widgets that work seamlessly with the reactive_forms package. It allows developers to handle date and time selection as part of a reactive form group.
use_when: You are building forms using the reactive_forms package
You need date or time pickers that bind directly to reactive form controls
avoid_when: you are not using reactive_forms in your project
strengths: Integrates date and time pickers with reactive_forms
Supports customizable pickers, formatters, and input decorator properties
weaknesses: Strictly coupled to the reactive_forms ecosystem
